title: Kiln install receipt (<game>/kiln/.install.json), format 1
description: Written last by the installer (after dinput8.dll is in place). Upgrade deletes an obsolete file only when its sha256 still equals the receipt's; uninstall restores everything in 'replaced' byte-identically and keeps kiln/. The launcher keeps a copy in <data>/installs/<installId>.json.

files.description: What this install put in place, relative to the game folder.

class.description: pe::classify_proxy result; file = not a proxy (any other replaced file).

action.description: chained: moved to kiln/chain/ and listed in chain.ini [chain]; backed-up: moved to the backup only (ShroudForge); replaced: a file with other bytes, backed up and restored by uninstall; adopted: existed before with the bundle's exact bytes (or a config file), left in place and kept by uninstall (no backup; becomes replaced when an upgrade changes it).

chainPath.description: action chained: its new place, e.g. kiln/chain/emf-dinput8.dll

backup.description: Byte-identical copy, relative to the game folder: kiln/backups/install-<yyyymmddThhmmssZ>/<path>.
